svg.title: Aashish Thakuri terminal profile
svg.desc: An expanded developer profile with animated skill symbols beside a living high-density character portrait reconstructed entirely from terminal glyphs.

g.aria-label: slow falling code behind the portrait
profile identity and capabilities written as terminal source
g.text: I WRITE CODE BECAUSE "LOOKED GREAT IN MY HEAD"
IS STILL NOT A DEPLOYMENT STRATEGY.
I see every interface as a piece of art with a purpose.
I turn symbols, stories, and ideas into visual language,
then build them into websites people can feel and understand.
Design is not decoration to me.
Every line, movement, and interaction should mean something.
I build to make difficult systems visible,
intuitive, expressive, and easier to understand.
Every interaction should carry intention, not just function.
Music and writing keep my imagination moving.
I am always observing, learning, testing, and refining.
Every interface can carry a symbol.
Every interaction can tell part of the story.
